title: Plugin reload request (POST /v1/plugins/{id}/reload)
description: Spec: docs/specs/agent-protocol.md §2. The body is optional. Without it the agent disables and enables the plugin. With proofstone-reload-command the agent runs that console command as the plugin's declared reload hook instead. The reply is config.json#/$defs/empty. Added in protocol 1.1 (T-M2-03), additive: no existing schema changes.
